<section id="quickstart">
<h1>
Quickstart
<a class="headerlink" href="#quickstart" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h1>
<p>
This is a lightning introduction to the most important features of Hypothesis; enough to get you started writing tests. The 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="tutorial/index.html">
<span class="doc">tutorial</span>
</a>
 introduces these features (and more) in greater detail.
</p>
<section id="install-hypothesis">
<h2>
Install Hypothesis
<a class="headerlink" href="#install-hypothesis" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<div class="highlight-shell notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
pip
<span class="w"> </span>
install
<span class="w"> </span>
hypothesis

</pre>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="write-your-first-test">
<h2>
Write your first test
<a class="headerlink" href="#write-your-first-test" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>
Create a new file called 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">example.py</span>
</code>
, containing a simple test:
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="c1"># contents of example.py</span>
<span class="kn">from</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nn">hypothesis</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="kn">import</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="n">given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">strategies</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">st</span>

<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">())</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_integers</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#print">
<span class="nb">print</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="sa">f</span>
<span class="s2">"called with </span>
<span class="si">{</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="si">}</span>
<span class="s2">"</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#isinstance">
<span class="nb">isinstance</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int">
<span class="nb">int</span>
</a>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">test_integers</span>
<span class="p">()</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">@given</span>
</code>
</a>
 is the standard entrypoint to Hypothesis. It takes a 
<em>strategy</em>
, which describes the type of inputs you want the decorated function to accept. When we call 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">test_integers</span>
</code>
, Hypothesis will generate random integers (because we used the 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">integers()</span>
</code>
</a>
 strategy) and pass them as 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">n</span>
</code>
. Let’s see that in action now by running 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">python</span> <span class="pre">example.py</span>
</code>
:
</p>
<div class="highlight-none notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
called with 0
called with -18588
called with -672780074
called with 32616
...

</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
We just called 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">test_integers()</span>
</code>
, without passing a value for 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">n</span>
</code>
, because Hypothesis generates random values of 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">n</span>
</code>
 for us.
</p>
<div class="admonition note">
<p class="admonition-title">
Note
</p>
<p>
By default, Hypothesis generates 100 random inputs. You can control this with the 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.settings.max_examples" title="hypothesis.settings.max_examples">
<code class="xref py py-obj docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">max_examples</span>
</code>
</a>
 setting.
</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="running-in-a-test-suite">
<h2>
Running in a test suite
<a class="headerlink" href="#running-in-a-test-suite" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>A Hypothesis test is still a regular python function, which means pytest or unittest will pick it up and run it in all the normal ways.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="c1"># contents of example.py</span>
<span class="kn">from</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nn">hypothesis</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="kn">import</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="n">given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">strategies</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">st</span>

<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="mi">0</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">200</span>
<span class="p">))</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_integers</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="o"><</span> <span class="mi">50</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
This test will clearly fail, which can be confirmed by running 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest</span> <span class="pre">example.py</span>
</code>
:
</p>
<div class="highlight-none notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
$ pytest example.py

    ...

    @given(st.integers())
    def test_integers(n):
>       assert n < 50
E       assert 50 < 50
E       Failing test case: test_integers(
E           n=50,
E       )

</pre>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="arguments-to-given">
<h2>
Arguments to 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">@given</span>
</code>
</a>
<a class="headerlink" href="#arguments-to-given" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>
You can pass multiple arguments to 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">@given</span>
</code>
</a>
:
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(),</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.text" title="hypothesis.strategies.text">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">text</span>
</a>
<span class="p">())</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_integers</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">s</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#isinstance">
<span class="nb">isinstance</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int">
<span class="nb">int</span>
</a>
<span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#isinstance">
<span class="nb">isinstance</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">s</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str">
<span class="nb">str</span>
</a>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>Or use keyword arguments:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(),</span> <span class="n">s</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.text" title="hypothesis.strategies.text">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">text</span>
</a>
<span class="p">())</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_integers</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">s</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#isinstance">
<span class="nb">isinstance</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int">
<span class="nb">int</span>
</a>
<span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#isinstance">
<span class="nb">isinstance</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">s</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str">
<span class="nb">str</span>
</a>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="admonition note">
<p class="admonition-title">
Note
</p>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">@given</span>
</code>
</a>
 for details about how 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">@given</span>
</code>
</a>
 handles different types of arguments.
</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="filtering-inside-a-test">
<h2>
Filtering inside a test
<a class="headerlink" href="#filtering-inside-a-test" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>
Sometimes, you need to remove invalid cases from your test. The best way to do this is with 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.SearchStrategy.filter" title="hypothesis.strategies.SearchStrategy.filter">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">.filter()</span>
</code>
</a>
:
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">()</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.SearchStrategy.filter" title="hypothesis.strategies.SearchStrategy.filter">
<span class="n">filter</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="o">%</span> <span class="mi">2</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
<span class="p">))</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_integers</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="o">%</span> <span class="mi">2</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
For more complicated conditions, you can use 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.assume" title="hypothesis.assume">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">assume()</span>
</code>
</a>
, which tells Hypothesis to discard any 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="glossary.html#term-test-case">
<span class="xref std std-term">test case</span>
</a>
 with a false-y argument:
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(),</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">())</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_integers</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n1</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n2</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.assume" title="hypothesis.assume">
<span class="n">assume</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n1</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="n">n2</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="c1"># n1 and n2 are guaranteed to be different here</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="admonition note">
<p class="admonition-title">
Note
</p>
<p>
You can learn more about 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.SearchStrategy.filter" title="hypothesis.strategies.SearchStrategy.filter">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">.filter()</span>
</code>
</a>
 and 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.assume" title="hypothesis.assume">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">assume()</span>
</code>
</a>
 in the 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="tutorial/adapting-strategies.html">
<span class="doc">Adapting strategies</span>
</a>
 tutorial page.
</p>
</div>

<section id="dependent-generation">
<h2>
Dependent generation
<a class="headerlink" href="#dependent-generation" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>
You may want an input to depend on the value of another input. For instance, you might want to generate two integers 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">n1</span>
</code>
 and 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">n2</span>
</code>
 where 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">n1</span> <span class="pre"><=</span> <span class="pre">n2</span>
</code>
.
</p>
<p>
You can do this using the 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.composite" title="hypothesis.strategies.composite">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">@composite</span>
</code>
</a>
 strategy. 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.composite" title="hypothesis.strategies.composite">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">@composite</span>
</code>
</a>
 lets you define a new strategy which is itself built by drawing values from other strategies, using the automatically-passed 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">draw</span>
</code>
 function.
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.composite" title="hypothesis.strategies.composite">
<span class="nd">@st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">composite</span>
</a>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">ordered_pairs</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">draw</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">n1</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">draw</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">())</span>
    <span class="n">n2</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">draw</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">min_value</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="n">n1</span>
<span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">n1</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n2</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">ordered_pairs</span>
<span class="p">())</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_pairs_are_ordered</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">pair</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">n1</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n2</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pair</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">n1</span> <span class="o"><=</span> <span class="n">n2</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
In more complex cases, you might need to interleave generation and test code. In this case, use 
<a class="reference internal link-preview" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.data" title="hypothesis.strategies.data">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">data()</span>
</code>
</a>
.
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.data" title="hypothesis.strategies.data">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">data</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(),</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.text" title="hypothesis.strategies.text">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">text</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">min_size</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="mi">1</span>
<span class="p">))</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_string_characters_are_substrings</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">data</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">string</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#isinstance">
<span class="nb">isinstance</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">string</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str">
<span class="nb">str</span>
</a>
<span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">index</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">data</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">draw</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="mi">0</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#len">
<span class="nb">len</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">string</span>
<span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
<span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">string</span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="n">index</span>
<span class="p">]</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">string</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>

<section id="combining-hypothesis-with-pytest">
<h2>
Combining Hypothesis with pytest
<a class="headerlink" href="#combining-hypothesis-with-pytest" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>
Hypothesis works with pytest features, like 
<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/reference.html#pytest-mark-parametrize-ref" title="(in pytest v9.1.1)">
<span class="xref std std-ref">pytest.mark.parametrize</span>
</a>
:
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="kn">import</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/index.html#module-pytest">
<span class="nn">pytest</span>
</a>

<span class="kn">from</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nn">hypothesis</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="kn">import</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="n">given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">strategies</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">st</span>

<span class="nd">@pytest</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">mark</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">parametrize</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="s2">"operation"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#reversed">
<span class="nb">reversed</span>
</a>
<span class="p">,</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#sorted">
<span class="nb">sorted</span>
</a>
<span class="p">])</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.lists" title="hypothesis.strategies.lists">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">lists</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">()))</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_list_operation_preserves_length</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">operation</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lst</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#len">
<span class="nb">len</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">lst</span>
<span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#len">
<span class="nb">len</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#list">
<span class="nb">list</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">operation</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">lst</span>
<span class="p">)))</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>Hypothesis also works with pytest fixtures:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="kn">import</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/index.html#module-pytest">
<span class="nn">pytest</span>
</a>

<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/reference.html#pytest.fixture" title="pytest.fixture">
<span class="nd">@pytest</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">fixture</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">scope</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="s2">"session"</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">shared_mapping</span>
<span class="p">():</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
<span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#range">
<span class="nb">range</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="mi">101</span>
<span class="p">)}</span>

<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/api.html#hypothesis.given" title="hypothesis.given">
<span class="nd">@given</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<a class="sphinx-codeautolink-a" href="reference/strategies.html#hypothesis.strategies.integers" title="hypothesis.strategies.integers">
<span class="n">st</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integers</span>
</a>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="mi">0</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">100</span>
<span class="p">))</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_shared_mapping_keys</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">shared_mapping</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">shared_mapping</span>
</pre>
</div>
